subject.title: [Feature]: Show additional information in `openclaw devices list`

question: Should this issue remain the broad tracking item for paired-device metadata/detail UX after the rename slice, or be narrowed to a specific `openclaw devices list` column/detail-mode change?
rationale: Current main stores much of the metadata, but the requested UX spans compact CLI output, possible `--full` detail mode, first-run/default-device explanation, and editable labels or notes that overlap a separate open rename PR.

options.title: Coordinate Broad Metadata UX
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracking item and define sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

options.title: Narrow To CLI Columns
options.body: Limit this issue to adding client/platform/activity columns in `openclaw devices list` and track notes, UI, and rename behavior separately.

options.title: Treat Rename As Enough
options.body: Close or narrow this issue once the rename PR lands, accepting that client/platform/activity/detail output is outside current product direction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Broad Metadata UX
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracking item and define sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current and historical signal across device auth, pairing storage, the devices CLI, and prior review context for this product boundary.
